pages.title: Summoning Process
pages.text:
1. Craft a Doll Egg (tier 1–5 or special variant)
2. Name it on an anvil
3. Right-click the ground with the named egg to summon

The egg is not consumed — it becomes bound to the doll. Right-click ground again to teleport the doll there.

Only a named egg can summon. Each egg is uniquely bound to its doll's UUID.

pages.title: Important Notes
pages.text:
• First-time players receive a Guide Book automatically (one per player per world)
• Right-click the doll with its egg to retrieve it; the egg carries inventory data
• When a doll dies, all its eggs become invalid

See "Dolls" category for normal egg recipes, and "Advanced Dolls" for special variants.
